workspaceSuite.skipReason: PostgreSQL integration needs a disposable database URL in the default suite; it was separately executed against a real local server.

postgres.runtime: Real PostgreSQL over loopback TCP. Domain HTTP handlers used Fastify inject and real service-owned PgRepository instances. Consumers invoked directly through transactional inbox; no live RabbitMQ was used.
checks: seven service-owned databases and non-superuser roles
forced tenant RLS including database owner without tenant context
transaction rollback includes domain and outbox
concurrent quote acceptance creates one pending contract
explicit contract approval and outbox commit together
duplicate inbox deliveries have no duplicate effects
one planning project and exact balanced invoice installments
concurrent payment records do not duplicate or exceed balance
outbox publication requires the correct lease token

coveredByTests: durable topology for all consumers before producer outbox drain
late first-start delivery queue provision regression fixture
rabbitmq.limitation: Broker restarts, actual quorum persistence, network faults and live delivery retries still require the Compose RabbitMQ environment.

regressions: cached command denied after changed signed principal claims
cached customer create rechecks current assignment
draft create/edit/revise/send recheck fresh CRM consent and assignment
list/detail/ticket authorization requires role plus owner id
dual-role quote visibility follows exact owning role
out-of-order customer events cannot reverse newer consent
delayed representative opt-out cannot overwrite newer customer opt-in
limits: Existing local-demo UI workflows are not claimed as fully connected to the new services.
Application contract approval is not a qualified electronic-signature service.
Recorded collections do not execute bank/card payments.
Communications sends in-app records, not external SMS or email.
Tracking stores only the latest point and requires fresh GPS from an open client.
